domain.fo2_grid_note: Fixed admitted grid used on both sources; IW-1 can fall below the live rail 1e-9 bar floor at low T and is not silently clamped.

alphamelts.coverage_finding: No independent gas-pressure API; direct helper also risks an unpooled VapoRock call, so no separate call is fabricated.
alphamelts.role: VapoRock condensed-melt solver and activity context

magemin.coverage_finding: No vapour-pressure API; matched MAGEMin plus ThermoEngine activity-evidence conversion is not runtime-wired.

vaporock.liquid_state_evidence: unverified_not_asserted; VapoRock internal melt solve used, but no external liquid_fraction value was fabricated

posture: Measured divergence is signal, not a pass/fail gate. Signed delta is log10(P_rail/P_VapoRock); no coefficient is adjusted by this harness.
